title: Transfer instructions and scheduled transfers - support procedure
content: The assistant can explain the synthetic transfer workflow and inspect a verified demo transfer record. It cannot execute real banking transactions. A request to move actual funds must use the bank's authenticated channel and applicable confirmation process.
